src='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Horizontal separator rows of color 3 partition equal-height tiles.
    cuts=[i for i,row in enumerate(g) if all(v==3 for v in row)]
    if not cuts: return g
    h=cuts[0]
    # Last tile is the source pattern; repeat it in each tile.
    source=g[cuts[-1]+1:]
    for start,end in zip([-1]+cuts,cuts+[len(g)]):
        if start==cuts[-1]: continue
        a=start+1; length=end-a
        if length==len(source):
            for k in range(length):
                for c,v in enumerate(source[k]):
                    if v!=grid[0][0]: g[a+k][c]=v
    return g
'''

src='''def transform(grid):
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0]); g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # Full monochrome rows/columns distinct from the background identify tile boundaries.
    bg=max(set(v for r in grid for v in r), key=lambda x:sum(r.count(x) for r in grid))
    rs=[i for i,r in enumerate(grid) if len(set(r))==1 and r[0]!=bg]
    cs=[j for j in range(W) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(H)})==1 and grid[0][j]!=bg]
    rb=[-1]+rs+[H]; cb=[-1]+cs+[W]
    # use bottom-right tile as motif; duplicate all its non-background cells across tiles
    r0=rb[-2]+1; c0=cb[-2]+1
    th=rb[-1]-r0; tw=cb[-1]-c0
    for ra,rz in zip(rb,rb[1:]):
        a=ra+1
        for ca,cz in zip(cb,cb[1:]):
            b=ca+1
            if rz-a!=th or cz-b!=tw: continue
            for y in range(th):
                for x in range(tw):
                    v=grid[r0+y][c0+x]
                    if v!=bg: g[a+y][b+x]=v
    return g
'''
open(p,'w').write(src)
exec(src)
